answer: At the zenith of the network, each node publishes a vertex‑signed challenge whose solution requires a tide‑locked proof‑of‑work that only a genuine identity can compute within a narrow time window; the challenge is duplicated as a honeypot answer for any grader that submits the same response as a peer. When two graders present identical honeypot answers, the system tags both as colluding sybils and revokes their stakes. The attacker must spend 0.5 ETH per fake identity as locked collateral and wait 24 hours for the tide‑window to expire, otherwise the stake is forfeited.
